# Los Ramos

> Los Ramos is a small indigenous community on Ometepe Island — a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve in Lake Nicaragua — offering family homestays and community-led cultural programs: Nicaraguan cooking classes, horseback tours, Spanish lessons, beekeeping, bird banding, kayaking, farm visits, and community theater. Every dollar visitors spend goes directly to local families. Bookings are made by email; no deposit is required and payment is in cash on arrival.

Key facts:

- Location: Los Ramos, Ometepe Island, Rivas, Nicaragua — 16 km south of Moyogalpa port, between the island's two volcanoes.
- Booking: email losramoscommunity@gmail.com with your program, group size, and dates. No deposit; pay cash (USD or Nicaraguan córdoba) on arrival.
- Homestays: $10 per room per night, plus $15 per day for three home-cooked meals, hosted by local families.
- Languages: Spanish; a bilingual community member helps English-speaking guests.
- Programs can be booked as standalone day visits — an overnight stay is not required.

Programs and prices (per person):

- Spanish Lessons — $10/hour, personalized lessons with a bilingual community member.
- Bird Banding Experience — $20, full day with local researchers, meal included.
- Cultural Cooking Class — $20, 3-hour traditional nacatamal class with local women, meal included. Most popular program.
- Los Ramos Theater — $10, 1-hour community performance of island history and culture.
- Beekeeping Class — $25, full day with local beekeepers including honey tasting, meal included.
- Mirador Horseback Tour — $20, 3-hour ride to two lookouts over Lake Nicaragua.
- By Land and By Sea — $30, half-day panga boat ride and kayaking on the Istian River.
- Nourishing Nicaragua — $20, half-day farm-to-table tour of two family farms, meal included.
- Milking Tour — $10, half-day traditional hand-milking visit to a family farm.

Getting there:

- From Managua (MGA airport): bus or shuttle about 2.5 hours south to San Jorge, Rivas, then ferry to Ometepe Island (about 1 hour crossing).
- From Costa Rica: cross at Peñas Blancas, bus or taxi to Rivas, continue to the San Jorge ferry dock.
- From Moyogalpa port: Los Ramos is 16 km south. The community can help arrange local transport — email when booking.
